verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents managing multiple companies (entities) under one login. Consolidated multi-entity reporting appears only through a third-party Joiin integration, not as a native consolidation feature. Missing for 10: native consolidated financial statements, intercompany eliminations, detailed docs on how consolidation works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: Puzzle supports managing multiple companies (entities) under one login.
